docs.summary: Represents a parametric spline curve in 3D space.
The control points of the spline.
The tangent vectors for Hermite splines.
The type of spline interpolation.
Whether the spline is closed (forms a loop).
Tension parameter for cardinal splines (0 = Catmull-Rom).
Custom up vectors for UpVectorMethod.Custom.
Fixed world up vector for UpVectorMethod.FixedWorldUp.
